concepts.proposed_markdown: - [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-mobile-android-requirements]] — 2026-09-15 Android Mobile device/OS/security requirements and card-reader/dock-specific NYC1, PIN, SDK and firmware gates; region and method availability remain separate.
warnings: The page's Android 12, March 2022 patch and SDK/firmware floors are dated minimums, not current approval for any device or payment method.
NYC1 and dock conditions apply to the card-reader solution; do not generalize PIN, USB dock, or reader version requirements to every Android Mobile path.
